instruction: A cinematic still captured from a slightly low angle in a medium shot. On an outdoor wooden boardwalk with a metal railing, surrounded by lush green trees, four friends are interacting. On the left, the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) stands in profile facing right, reaching out to clasp hands with the man in the grey t-shirt (R4) who stands on the right facing left. Slightly behind them, the woman in the beige hoodie (R1) stands facing right with a cheerful smile, while the woman in the grey hijab (R3) stands second from the right, looking at the hand clasp with a bright, joyful smile. Bright, warm sunlight filters through the canopy, creating a backlit effect with soft lens flare and a warm color palette.
elements: R2 initiates the hand clasp by reaching out to R4
R2 and R4 are the hand-clasping contact pair
R3 watches the hand clasp rather than participating in it
R1 stands slightly behind the hand-clasping pair and smiles
The setting is an outdoor wooden boardwalk with a metal railing
